priorities.summary: Kyverno before 1.19.1 fails to validate URL-encoded path segments in the Policy apiCall urlPath, letting namespace tenants bypass the per-namespace clamp and create objects in other namespaces as the admission-controller ServiceAccount — including cluster-wide MutatingWebhookConfigurations, escalating to cluster admin. Fixed in 1.19.1.

A heap-based buffer overflow in F5 BIG-IP APM's Traffic Management Microkernel, reachable through the OAuth authorization endpoint, allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root when a virtual server has both an APM access policy and an OAuth authorization server profile configured.

A directory traversal and file upload vulnerability in Check Point Management Server allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts on the management server. Actively exploited in the wild; added to CISA KEV.

model.name: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol & Luna
model.summary: OpenAI launched two cheaper GPT-6 models on Sept 22 — Sol ($2/$10 per million tokens) for coding and agentic work, and Luna ($0.10/$0.50) for high-volume routine tasks — cutting API prices about 50% versus GPT-5.6. They sit below flagship GPT-6 Astra and shipped the same day in the API, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.
